name: Ace Bug
source:
A huge war divides humanity to two camps. Each side decides to play the trump card to take the upper hand. And the trump card is human-shaped androids, a perfect weapon to decide the fate of this world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一场规模空前的战争将人类分成两大阵营。双方都决定打出王牌，以取得优势。而这张王牌就是人形安卓机器人，一种决定世界命运的完美武器。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
